blocks.text: Questions before you go live Answers for teams evaluating models, moving applications and planning production. Discuss your requirements Can we move an existing AI application to Sarvam? Sarvam supports OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs. Update your endpoint, key and model, then validate the parameters, tool calls and outputs your application uses. Read the API guide How do we know a model will meet our quality requirements? Leading open models perform competitively on coding, reasoning and other published evaluations. The right choice depends on your workload. Validate answer quality, tool use and response times on representative requests. Compare published scores on Artificial Analysis . Where is our inference processed? Model inference runs on Sarvam-operated GPUs in India. Sarvam hosts the weights; requests are not forwarded to the original model developer’s overseas API. External tools connected by your application have their own processing locations and data policies. What does zero data retention cover? Zero data retention is available on request. Under an agreed ZDR arrangement, prompts and responses are not retained. Operational logs are scoped separately in the terms for your deployment. Is our data used to train models for other customers? No. Sarvam does not use customer data to train models for other customers. The original model developer does not receive your inference requests. Your data-processing agreement defines the permitted use and handling of your data. How will Sarvam handle our traffic and latency targets? Sarvam manages serving capacity as traffic changes. Share your expected concurrency, prompt lengths, peak traffic and response-time targets so the team can size the deployment. Available capacity and rate limits depend on your model, deployment and account. Can we switch models as our needs change? Yes. Select supported models through the API’s model field. Context limits, input types and tool behaviour vary, so validate your application when changing models. You can use all models listed in the catalogue with a single API key by changing the model name. What production support and SLAs are available? Sarvam’s engineers can support evaluation, integration and migration. For production, discuss the capacity plan, availability targets, support response times and escalation process with the team. Service commitments are agreed for your enterprise deployment. Discuss SLA What can we share with our security and procurement teams? Request Sarvam’s ISO 27001:2022 certificate, SOC 2 Type II report, penetration-test summary and data-processing documentation through the Trust Center. Some documents are shared under NDA. Your security team can review their scope against the planned deployment. Visit the Trust Center

lines.text: Answers for teams evaluating models, moving applications and planning production.
Can we move an existing AI application to Sarvam?

Sarvam supports OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs. Update your endpoint, key and model, then validate the parameters, tool calls and outputs your application uses. Read the API guide
How do we know a model will meet our quality requirements?

Leading open models perform competitively on coding, reasoning and other published evaluations. The right choice depends on your workload. Validate answer quality, tool use and response times on representative requests. Compare published scores on Artificial Analysis .

Model inference runs on Sarvam-operated GPUs in India. Sarvam hosts the weights; requests are not forwarded to the original model developer’s overseas API. External tools connected by your application have their own processing locations and data policies.
What does zero data retention cover?
Zero data retention is available on request. Under an agreed ZDR arrangement, prompts and responses are not retained. Operational logs are scoped separately in the terms for your deployment.
Is our data used to train models for other customers?

No. Sarvam does not use customer data to train models for other customers. The original model developer does not receive your inference requests. Your data-processing agreement defines the permitted use and handling of your data.
How will Sarvam handle our traffic and latency targets?

Sarvam manages serving capacity as traffic changes. Share your expected concurrency, prompt lengths, peak traffic and response-time targets so the team can size the deployment. Available capacity and rate limits depend on your model, deployment and account.
Can we switch models as our needs change?

Yes. Select supported models through the API’s model field. Context limits, input types and tool behaviour vary, so validate your application when changing models. You can use all models listed in the catalogue with a single API key by changing the model name.
What production support and SLAs are available?

Sarvam’s engineers can support evaluation, integration and migration. For production, discuss the capacity plan, availability targets, support response times and escalation process with the team. Service commitments are agreed for your enterprise deployment. Discuss SLA
What can we share with our security and procurement teams?

Request Sarvam’s ISO 27001:2022 certificate, SOC 2 Type II report, penetration-test summary and data-processing documentation through the Trust Center. Some documents are shared under NDA. Your security team can review their scope against the planned deployment. Visit the Trust Center
